name: neuro-stim
description: Neuromodulation research-engineering workflows: stimulation safety limits, TMS/tES field modeling, DBS sensing data, focused-ultrasound dosing, nerve-stimulation models and sham design, with tool references for SimNIBS, ROAST, Percept exports, Lead-DBS, k-Wave, BabelBrain, NEURON and ASCENT. Research support, not clinical decisions.
